claims: Chipotle is hosting a Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) deal for the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs on April 20, 2026, after 3 p.m. local time.
Customers wearing a hockey jersey or apparel at participating U.S. and Canada locations can purchase one entree and get one free in-restaurant.
The BOGO deal is buy one entree, get one free.
The BOGO deal has a maximum of five free items per check.
The BOGO deal is on Monday, April 20, 2026, after 3 p.m. local time.
The BOGO deal requires wearing a hockey jersey to a participating store.
The BOGO deal is only valid in-restaurant, not for online, mobile, or delivery orders.
Chipotle released a limited-edition, custom-branded hockey jersey for the first time.
Fans could enter for a chance to win a custom-branded jersey by exchanging 10 Rewards points via the Chipotle Rewards Exchange.
The entry period for the jersey ran from April 18 to May 2, 2026.
